ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Jupiter at {H:1815723679000}

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1815737944000}, the Moon is still in {S:8} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.
